question: Iron phosphate cathode powder is LiFePO4. With atomic masses Li 7, Fe 56, P 31, O 16, what percentage is lithium?
move: The ingredient a thing is named after may be the smallest part of it.
trap: Expecting the metal on the label to be a large share of the powder.
hint: Add the masses of every atom in the formula, then take lithium's slice.
reference: Prohaska et al., Standard atomic weights of the elements 2021 (IUPAC Technical Report), Pure and Applied Chemistry, 2022
